# Bend Fence & Deck

> Family-owned fence, deck and covered patio builder for homeowners in Central Oregon. Every project starts with a custom design meeting & free estimate.

## Services
- Fences: cedar privacy, horizontal, ranch, metal and corrugated fences, gates and repairs
- Decks: new decks, replacements, stairs, railings and repairs
- Composite decks: Trex and TimberTech
- Pergolas, covered decks, covered patios and porches
- Siding: cedar, shake and Hardie
- Paver patios, outdoor kitchens and whole-backyard design

## Areas served
Bend, Redmond, Sisters, Sunriver, La Pine, Prineville, Tumalo, Powell Butte and Madras, Oregon.

## Facts
- Locally owned and operated by Brian Wallace and his family
- Oregon CCB #204674
- Reviews: 4.8 stars from 23 Google reviews
- Builds year-round, including winter
